kwargs.prompt: Hot-reload MCP on every down: toggle the Cursor enable switch off then on so the server respawns.
kwargs.thinking: Cursor marks some MCP disconnects as non-retryable, so in-process retry cannot recover. Recovery is the same UI switch: write disabled=true on the spotify-rip mcp.json entries, wait, then disabled=false. A sidecar (python -m mcp_server.bus.guardian) outlives stdio, watches process death and Cursor MCP error logs, and fires that bounce with a 12s debounce. Spawn is gated by MCP_TOGGLE_GUARDIAN=1 so pytest never flips the real switch. worker_alive(None) must not fall through to the celery pid or the sidecar would never start.
kwargs.outcome: Toggle sidecar is live (guardian pid 79240 watching MCP 78450). User/project mcp.json now carry MCP_TOGGLE_GUARDIAN=1 and an explicit disabled=false switch. On down, the guardian flips that switch off then on so Cursor respawns user-spotify-rip.
